identity.name: Royal Oak Chronograph 41
identity.one_liner: The 2017 Royal Oak chronograph refresh whose silver-and-black panda dial became the collected configuration.

narrative.story: Marking 20 years of the Royal Oak chronograph in 2017, the 26331ST reworked the 41mm chrono's dial: larger registers pushed outward, cleaner minute track, and a silver grande tapisserie face with black counters — the panda — that instantly became the one to have. Inside remained the compact F. Piguet-based caliber 2385. The reference ran until the 26240 generation with AP's integrated flyback 4401 took over in 2022.
narrative.collector_notes: The panda and reverse-panda dominate demand over the blue and black dials. The 2385 is a modular-free, thin chronograph but lacks flyback and runs at 3Hz — check pusher action and register reset alignment.
